<div class="wrap">
<h1>Earnings quality</h1>
<p class="sub">Sloan accruals, cash conversion, and Beneish DSRI/GMI from the live earnings-quality feed. Click any column to sort ascending, click again to sort descending. Blank is missing, not zero.</p>
<input id="q" aria-label="Filter ticker or company" placeholder="filter ticker" autocomplete="off">
<div id="board" role="region" aria-label="Reported earnings quality rows" tabindex="0">Loading /data/earnings-quality.json</div>
<details><summary>Complete received earnings-quality packet</summary><pre id="original" tabindex="0">Unavailable</pre></details>
<div class="foot"><b>Built for:</b> seeing whether earnings are cash or accrual-heavy before treating growth as real.<br>
<b>Data:</b> /data/earnings-quality.json (ttm NI, OCF, FCF, Sloan % assets, cash conversion, DSRI, GMI, quality score).<br>
<b>Formulas:</b> Sloan = (NI − OCF) / assets when the producer tagged it. Cash conversion = OCF / NI when tagged. DSRI/GMI are the Beneish components on the row only.<br>
<b>Sort:</b> header click toggles asc/desc. Nulls sort last. Not a full Beneish M-score, ARR, or guidance.</div>
</div>
<script src="/jh-table-values.js"></script>
<script>
function esc(s){return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];});}
function n(v,d){return JHTableValues.format(v,d==null?1:d);}
function cls(v){return JHTableValues.sign(v,"neg","pos");}
function cmp(a,b,k,dir){
  return JHTableValues.compare(a,b,k,dir,k==="ticker"||k==="name"?"text":"number");
}
(async function(){
  var d=null, SORT="quality_score", DIR=-1;
  try{var received=await JHTableValues.load("/data/earnings-quality.json");d=received.packet;document.getElementById("original").textContent=received.raw;}catch(e){if(typeof e.original_text==='string')document.getElementById('original').textContent=e.original_text;document.getElementById("board").textContent=e.message;return;}
  var rows=(d&&(d.all_ranked||d.top_20_high_quality))||[];
  if(!Array.isArray(rows)){document.getElementById("board").textContent="Published population is malformed; inspect the original packet.";return;}
  var malformed=rows.filter(function(x){return !x||typeof x!=="object"||Array.isArray(x);}).length;
  rows=rows.filter(function(x){return x&&typeof x==="object"&&!Array.isArray(x);});
  var cols=[["ticker","Ticker","l"],["name","Name","l"],["sloan_accruals_pct_assets","Sloan % assets",""],["cash_conversion_ratio","Cash conv",""],["dsri_beneish","DSRI",""],["gmi_beneish","GMI",""],["quality_score","Quality",""]];
  function paint(){
    var q=(document.getElementById("q").value||"").toUpperCase();
    var list=rows.filter(function(x){return !q||String(x.ticker||"").toUpperCase().indexOf(q)>=0||String(x.name||"").toUpperCase().indexOf(q)>=0;});
    list.sort(function(a,b){return cmp(a,b,SORT,DIR);});
    var h="<table><thead><tr>";
    cols.forEach(function(c){h+="<th class='"+(c[2]||"")+(SORT===c[0]?" on":"")+"' data-k="+c[0]+">"+c[1]+(SORT===c[0]?(DIR>0?" ↑":" ↓"):"")+"</th>";});
    h+="</tr></thead><tbody>";
    list.forEach(function(x){
      h+="<tr><td class=l><a href=/ticker.html?symbol="+encodeURIComponent(x.ticker)+" style=color:#fff>"+esc(x.ticker)+"</a></td>";
      h+="<td class=l>"+esc(x.name||"")+"</td>";
      h+="<td class="+cls(x.sloan_accruals_pct_assets)+">"+n(x.sloan_accruals_pct_assets)+"</td>";
      h+="<td>"+n(x.cash_conversion_ratio,2)+"</td>";
      h+="<td>"+n(x.dsri_beneish,2)+"</td>";
      h+="<td>"+n(x.gmi_beneish,2)+"</td>";
      h+="<td>"+n(x.quality_score,1)+"</td></tr>";
    });
    document.getElementById("board").innerHTML=h+"</tbody></table><p class=sub>"+list.length+" of "+rows.length+" received rows. "+malformed+" malformed rows retained in the original packet. Producer publication "+esc(d.as_of||"unavailable")+"; underlying period freshness is unverified. Click headers or press Enter/Space to sort.</p>";
    JHTableValues.bindSort(document.querySelectorAll("#board th[data-k]"),SORT,DIR,function(k){if(SORT===k)DIR=-DIR;else{SORT=k;DIR=k==="ticker"||k==="name"?1:-1;}paint();});
  }
  if(!rows.length){document.getElementById("board").textContent="Received population has no displayable rows. Malformed rows: "+malformed+". Inspect the complete packet.";return;}
  document.getElementById("q").oninput=paint; paint();
})();
</script>
